column1: # CROSS-ORGANIZATION high-coverage confirmatory corpus (RQ1) — see PREREG.md.
# HELD OUT BY ORGANIZATION, not merely by repository. The developmental + prior confirmatory sets are
# Apache Commons (io, exec, dbcp2, compress, vfs2, configuration2, csv, lang3, text, collections4, codec,
# dbutils, beanutils, validator, jexl, digester3) plus zip4j / jsoup / joda-time / jackson-* / nanohttpd.
# NONE of those, and no repo from those organizations, appears here: every classifier fix candor carries
# was developed against code authored by someone else than the authors below.
# `-Denforcer.skip=true` appears in build commands because several of these projects pin a maven-enforcer
# JDK range that excludes the JDK 21 this harness runs on. It relaxes a BUILD-POLICY check only; it does
# not alter sources, dependencies, or bytecode semantics.
